doc: Single source for the master content sheet: column order, owner, dropdown values, source mapping. Read by scripts/master/seed.mjs (Lessons tab + CSV), scripts/master/parity.mjs and the future dashboard. Owner: TEAM = the team edits it; SYSTEM = written by the seed/sync, protected (editor: the service account only). protected = a protected range in the sheet (every SYSTEM column and lesson_code). Described in docs/master-sheet.md. Decisions: docs/kiro-bulk-08.md.

columns.source: Assigned once at seed (M00001...), never changes; the row's identity. Order: file name, tab order, sheet row.
catalogue-build lessonIdOf via planCatalogue (code, else d-<source drive id>); recomputed on every seed/sync. Empty when no source and no code.
data/course-ids.json registry via planCatalogue (file id + tab). No new ids in a dry run.
data/teacher-files.json (file -> slug) shown as the teacher's Khmer display name (name_km); pending files show: pending.
catalogue-build courseTitle (section row above the first lesson, else the tab name).
No source in the sheets; empty.

Lesson-code column (both spellings). Protected: only the coordinator's account changes it.

yes = approved AND visible in the catalogue (planCatalogue visible). Not what the app shows today (app switch: bulk 09).
Acast column: done -> posted, empty -> to do; an Acast embed link present -> posted. 'not needed' is team-only (never seeded).

Hide reason from the catalogue, plus: hidden tab, no title, no source, no code, acast embed missing. Joined with '; '.
